skills.name: SQLMap reporting: Write executive summary
skills.description: Explain the result to service owners without excess SQLMap jargon.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Report the exact approved endpoint and input with secrets redacted.
2. Separate observed SQLMap evidence, confidence, impact, and test limitations.
3. State scope, whether an issue was confirmed, high-level impact, and immediate owner action; omit raw data.
4. Recommend owner-side remediation and an authorized minimal retest.

Safety: report only minimum redacted evidence from owner-authorized tests. Never include dumped records, credentials, server files, or out-of-scope data.
